member.name: M:CodeKids.Api.Controllers.StagesController.PurchaseHint(System.Guid,CodeKids.Api.DTOs.Stages.HintRequestDto)
member.summary: Purchase a hint for a question within a stage.
member.remarks:
Hints cost flames and escalate in price within the same stage for the child: - 1st hint: 100 flames - 2nd hint: 150 flames - 3rd hint: 200 flames (+50 flames each time)
If the child does not have sufficient flames, returns 409 Conflict with ProblemDetails.
Sample request:
POST /stages/{stageId}/hint { "childId": "3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6", "questionId": "7cb85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa1" }

member.name: M:CodeKids.Api.Controllers.StagesController.CompleteStage(System.Guid,CodeKids.Api.DTOs.Stages.CompleteStageRequestDto)
member.remarks:
Idempotent (calling twice never doubles flames). Executed within a single database transaction (progress, flames, transactions, streak, badges).
Rewards: - Explanation: 10 flames - Quiz: 25 flames - Final: 60 flames - Streak bonus: +5 flames per consecutive day (capped at +50)
Replaying a completed stage is allowed for practice but grants 0 flames.
Sample request:
POST /stages/{stageId}/complete { "childId": "3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6", "hintsUsed": 1, "attempts": 2 }

member.name: M:CodeKids.Api.Services.StreakService.Calculate(System.Int32,System.Nullable{System.DateTime},System.DateTime)
member.summary: Pure method for calculating streak days and bonus flames based on UTC dates. Rules: - First day: streak = 1, bonus = 5. - Same day: no change in streak, no second bonus (bonus = 0). - Next consecutive day: streak = streak + 1, bonus = min(streak * 5, 50). - Skipped day: streak resets to 1, bonus = 5.
